api: TokenLedger (src/gameplay/match/token_ledger.gd): class_name TokenLedger extends RefCounted; keyed by UnitStats.type_id, one Dictionary[StringName,int] per Player, copied per key, never holds stock.counts.

TokenLedger.start(stock: TokenStock, types: Array[UnitStats], player_count: int) -> void  (copies stock.count_of(type_id) per Player and type, never below 0; remembers the first can_carry type as the carrier; a null stock = one push_error and an empty ledger, nobody has lost; null entries of types skipped; player_count <= 0 = no Player)
TokenLedger.count_of(player_index: int, type_id: StringName) -> int  (0 for an unknown id, an empty id, a Player outside the range, before start())

TokenLedger.take(player_index: int, type_id: StringName) -> bool  (true and subtracts one; at 0, for an unknown or empty type_id, or a Player outside the range: changes nothing, pushes exactly ONE warning prefixed 'TokenLedger: no Token was taken', returns false)
TokenLedger.has_lost(player_index: int) -> bool  (the carrier's count is 0; false outside the range, before start(), and while there is no carrier type)
TokenLedger.carrier_type_id() -> StringName  (&"" before start() or when no type can carry)

static TokenLedger.first_problem(stock: TokenStock, types: Array[UnitStats]) -> String  (STATIC, callable as TokenLedger.first_problem(...); '' when fine; order: stock null 'the Map has no Token stock' / negative count (names the type_id) / stock key no type has (names the key) / empty type_id or two types sharing one (names the unit_types indexes) / no can_carry type 'no Unit type can carry the Flag, so no Player could lose' or several (names their display names) / carrier count < 1 'the Token stock gives no Token to <display_name>, the type that can carry the Flag, so a Player could neither carry a Flag nor lose'; a display_name that is empty falls back to the type_id)

MatchController.begin(units: Array[Unit], bases: Array[Base], cameras: Array[ChaseCamera], token_stock: TokenStock) -> void  (validates last with TokenLedger.first_problem(token_stock, rules.unit_types); a refusal is exactly ONE push_error "MatchController '<name>': <sentence>, so the Round does not begin." and changes nothing; a later begin() with good arguments on the same node works)

MatchController.tokens_left(player_index: int, type_index: int) -> int; can_choose(player_index: int, type_index: int) -> bool (= tokens_left > 0 and nothing else); carrier_type_index() -> int (-1 before a successful begin(), after a refused one, or when the live types hold no type of the carrier's id). All read-only, no signal, safe in any handler; 0 / false / -1 outside the bounds, never an index through -1.

MatchController.choose(player_index, type_index) now returns false, changes nothing and emits nothing for a type with 0 Tokens (the single guard of AC-3). restart() calls ledger.start() after state RUNNING and before the unpause and round_started. _on_unit_destroyed(): note_destroyed accepted -> FlagRules.drop -> ledger.take(player, destroyed Unit's stats.type_id) -> flag_dropped.emit -> unit_destroyed.emit (the Token is taken BEFORE flag_dropped as well, so every listener of either signal reads the new count).
